name: Death's Door
action: All Wanderers on or adjacent to the Golem go to 1 Health.

name: Deface
action: The Emperor trashes the next face-down Relic from the Golem's space.

name: Dissent
action: Each Wanderer on a Location with another Wanderer loses 3 Health.

name: Double Down
action: Play another action. Perform the next golem card twice.

name: Fire storm
action: 👊3 to Wanderers on or adjacent to the Golem's space. Each Wanderer who lost health as a result must trash one Relic they have equipped.

name: Great Sweeping Scythe
action: 👊5 to all Wanderers on or adjacent to the Golem's space. Give a Scar token to all Wanderers who lost Health.

name: Overcharge
action: Wanderers on spaces with Monolith Shards lose 1 Health for each Monolith Shard on or adjacent to their Location.

name: Penitence
action: Remove 1 Shame token.

name: Public Lashings
action: 🦶1 to the Wanderer with the most Shame tokens. If the Golem reaches them, 👊3 for each they have.

name: Public Shaming
action: Each Wanderer loses 2 Health for each Shame token they have.

name: Pursue
action: 🦶5 to the space of the farthest Wanderer. 👊2.

name: Quake
action: 🦶2 to the nearest Road. All Wanderers on spaces that contain Roads lose 2 Health. Return all infrastructure from that space back to the Emperor's infrastructure pool.

name: Roar
action: 👊3 all Wanderers on or adjacent to the Golem's space. All Wanderers on or adjacent to the Golem's space must 🦶1 space away in a direction they choose.

name: Sacrifice of Possessions
action: All Wanderers must trash one Relic they have equipped.

name: Scar
action: 🦶1 to the nearest Wanderer. Place a Scar token on their mat (see Wanderer mat for details on scars).

name: Self inscription
action: Add a 👺 Glyph to the Golem's mat.

name: Shard Devourer
action: 🦶2 to the nearest Monolith Shard token. Remove it, and 👊2 all Wanderers on or adjacent to its space.

name: Siege
action: 🦶2 to be adjacent to the nearest wall. All Wanderers adjacent to that wall lose 4 Health.

name: Spew
action: 👊2 for all Wanderers within 2 spaces.

name: Stalk
action: 🦶5 to the space of the Wanderer with the least Health.

name: Storm
action: All Wanderers lose 2 Health.

name: Summoning Roar
action: All Wanderers 🦶2 toward the Golem's space. 👊3 all Wanderers in the Golem's space.

name: Targeted attack
action: 🦶2 to the nearest Wanderer. If they have an Ally on or adjacent to the space, 👊5 to each.

name: Time Paradox
action: Play 2 additional Golem cards after this.
